summary: The direct-Mathlib-duplicate deletions are correct, but the PR removes the shared CM-level helper IsCompletelyMonotone.iteratedDerivWithin_Icc_eq_Ici (two consumers, no Mathlib equivalent) and inlines its identical hcda-derivation + transfer body in both call sites.
